title: In-Context Preference-Conditioned Pareto Set Learning from Limited Offline Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.21736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-objective optimization involves diverse preferences over conflicting objectives. Rather than returning a finite set of trade-off solutions, preference-conditioned Pareto set learning seeks to map a specified preference directly to a corresponding Pareto optimal solution. Yet in many real-world scenarios, optimization must proceed offline without further objective evaluations, leaving only a limited static dataset that sparsely covers the decision and objective spaces. Existing methods either optimize separately for each preference or train a problem-specific Pareto solution model, requiring repeated search across preferences or repeated training across problems. We introduce in-context preference-conditioned Pareto set learning (ICPSL), a framework that amortizes both preference-wise solution search and problem-specific model construction. ICPSL pretrains a foundation-style hypernetwork on a large and diverse set of synthetic prior

translated_title: 基于有限离线数据的上下文内偏好条件帕累托解集学习
translated_abstract: 多目标优化涉及针对相互冲突目标的多样化偏好。偏好条件帕累托解集学习旨在将指定的偏好直接映射到对应的帕累托最优解，而不是返回一个有限的权衡解集合。然而在许多现实场景中，优化必须在离线状态下进行，无法进一步评估目标函数，只能依靠一个稀疏覆盖决策空间与目标空间的有限静态数据集。现有方法要么针对每个偏好单独进行优化，要么训练针对特定问题的帕累托解模型，因而需要在偏好之间重复搜索，或在问题之间重复训练。我们提出了上下文内偏好条件帕累托解集学习（ICPSL），该框架能够同时摊销逐偏好的解搜索与针对特定问题的模型构建成本。ICPSL 在一个庞大且多样化的合成先验集合上预训练一个基础风格（foundation-style）的超网络
tldr: 提出 ICPSL 框架，通过在多样化合成先验数据上预训练基础式超网络，从有限的离线数据中实现上下文内偏好条件帕累托解集学习，同时摊销逐偏好搜索与跨问题重复训练的成本。
en_tdlr: ICPSL pretrains a foundation-style hypernetwork on diverse synthetic priors to enable in-context preference-conditioned Pareto set learning from limited offline data, amortizing both preference-wise solution search and problem-specific model construction.
